ac.ability.generic.brain_course.desc: Passive: increases maximum CP by 1,000, allowing longer casting sequences. LV3 · Requires: any LV3 skill
ac.ability.generic.brain_course_advanced: Advanced passive: adds 1,500 maximum CP and 100 maximum overload, stacking with Brain Training. LV4 · Requires: Brain Course、any LV4 skill
ac.ability.generic.mind_course.desc: Passive: increases natural CP recovery speed by 20% for sustained combat and exploration. LV5 · Requires: Brain Course Advanced、any LV5 skill

ac.ability.electromaster.arc_gen.desc: Tap to arc at the target under your crosshair. A direct creature hit deals electric damage; ground hits may ignite the space above. Useful at short to medium range, but hitting a Creeper may charge it. Releasing does not cancel an accepted arc. LV1
ac.ability.electromaster.mag_manip.desc: Target a magnetizable block to lift, move or throw it. Use actual blocks for clearing, cover or attacks; range and block protection still apply. LV2 · Requires: Magnet Movement 50%
ac.ability.electromaster.mine_detect.des: Tap for {{duration_ticks:s}} seconds of ore sensing: you become temporarily blind but can see supported nearby ore outlines. Range grows from {{reach_novice}} to {{reach_mastered}} m with mastery. Detects deposits without mining them. LV3 · Requires: Magnet Manipulation 100%
ac.ability.electromaster.railgun.desc: Hold the skill with an iron ingot or iron block in your main hand to charge and fire automatically. Alternatively, right-click to toss a coin, then press the skill at the firing window. Ammunition is consumed; check CP and the firing lane before this heavy straight-line shot. LV4 · Requires: Thunder Bolt 30%、Magnet Manipulation 100%
ac.ability.electromaster.mag_movement.de: Pull yourself toward a valid magnetic target for climbing or repositioning. Requires a magnetic anchor; it is not free flight. LV2 · Requires: Arc Generation、Current Charging 70%
ac.ability.electromaster.iron_sand.desc: Separate and manipulate the iron sand to creative a changeable and dangerous attack effect.
ac.ability.electromaster.charging.desc: Charge a supported energy block or a compatible held item using ability CP. The target determines its energy capacity. LV1 · Requires: Arc Generation 30%
Hold at least 0.5 seconds, then release to attempt enhancement. Longer charge up to 2 seconds improves the chance and strength of Jump Boost and Regeneration. Brief hunger follows, and buffs are random. Useful for terrain and short recovery, not guaranteed to grant every effect. LV3 · Requires: Arc Generation 100%、Current Charging 100%
ac.ability.electromaster.thunder_clap.de: LV5 area lightning. Keep holding to gather the storm; it fires automatically after about 3 seconds. Early release cancels. Damage falls with distance from impact; watch overload and nearby creatures. LV5 · Requires: Thunder Bolt 100% LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative.
ac.ability.electromaster.thunder_bolt.de: Tap to strike a target within {{reach}} m and discharge again within 8 m of the endpoint. With mastery, hits may briefly slow targets; useful against groups. LV4 · Requires: Arc Generation、Current Charging 70%

ac.ability.teleporter.mark_teleport.name: Mark Teleport
ac.ability.teleporter.flesh_ripping.name: Flesh Ripping

ac.ability.teleporter.threatening_telepo: Hold an item in your main hand, aim while holding the skill, then release to move the item to your aim. Hits on creatures can deal spatial damage. Moves real items, not the caster, and does not duplicate them. LV1
ac.ability.teleporter.dim_folding_theore: Passive: spatial-jump attacks can trigger a spatial split for increased damage. Chance grows with mastery; critical hits are not guaranteed. LV1 · Requires: Threatening Teleport 20%
ac.ability.teleporter.penetrate_teleport: Probe obstacles along your aim and teleport through when there is room beyond them. Useful for crossing walls; range and CP still limit travel, and a valid exit is required. LV2 · Requires: Threatening Teleport 50%
ac.ability.teleporter.mark_teleport.desc: Hold to extend the aiming distance, then release to teleport to the chosen location. Can use block surfaces, entities or open-air points; requires at least 3 m of movement and sufficient destination space. LV2 · Requires: Threatening Teleport 40%
ac.ability.teleporter.flesh_ripping.desc: Aim at a nearby creature and release to deal spatial tearing damage. A finite-damage precision attack at short to medium range; it can briefly cause nausea and respects target defenses. LV3 · Requires: Mark Teleport 50%、Penetrate Teleport 50%
Open the coordinate list to save your position and travel to a stored location, carrying eligible nearby creatures. Cross-dimensional travel unlocks above 80% mastery. Costs are high; check the destination and companions before departure. LV3 · Requires: Penetrate Teleport 80%、Mark Teleport 80%
ac.ability.teleporter.shift_tp.desc: Use a held block, hold to aim, then release to transfer it along a line, damaging targets in its path and attempting placement at the endpoint. Requires material, placement permission and free space. LV4 · Requires: Location Teleport 50%
ac.ability.teleporter.space_fluct.desc: Advanced passive: strengthens spatial splits and enables higher critical tiers. Stacks with Dimensional Folding to improve spatial attack burst potential. LV4 · Requires: Shift Teleport
ac.ability.teleporter.flashing.desc: LV5 rapid mobility. After activation, use movement keys for repeated short teleports during a limited window, spending CP each time. Works for aerial repositioning but needs valid endpoints; a long cooldown follows. LV5 · Requires: Shift Teleport 80% LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative.

ac.ability.meltdowner.electron_bomb.desc: Tap to create an electron orb following you. After a short delay it automatically fires a {{reach}} m beam along your aim. Releasing does not cancel; turn before firing to adjust the shot. Bodies and obstacles block the beam. LV1
ac.ability.meltdowner.rad_intensify.desc: Passive: Meltdowner attacks can apply radiation marks that strengthen subsequent Meltdowner hits. The multiplier grows with ability mastery; useful for focused fire. LV1 · Requires: Electron Bomb 50%
ac.ability.meltdowner.ray_barrage.desc: Tap to fire a beam. Aim at a thrown Silbarn to consume it and create a fan of scattered beams for frontal crowd pressure. Without a Silbarn hit, fires only a normal single beam. LV4 · Requires: Meltdowner 50%
ac.ability.meltdowner.scatter_bomb.desc: Hold to gather electron bombs: generation starts after 1 second and reaches its maximum by 4 seconds. Release to scatter the existing orbs. Useful for close-range coverage with imprecise endpoints. Holding too long can hurt you, and cancelling a prepared salvo can still fire it. LV2 · Requires: Electron Bomb 80%
ac.ability.meltdowner.meltdowner.desc: Hold to charge, then release a penetrating beam against enemies and destructible obstacles. High output increases personal risk and cost; useful for heavy breakthroughs. Terrain protection applies. LV3 · Requires: Scattering Bomb 80%、Light Shield 80%
ac.ability.meltdowner.light_shield.desc: Hold to deploy a light shield that spends CP to reduce incoming damage with a direct source, and burns close targets in front. Release to stop. Absorption has an interval and per-hit limit; source-less environmental damage is excluded. LV2 · Requires: Electron Bomb 100%
ac.ability.meltdowner.jet_engine.desc: Hold to aim, then release a rapid electron-jet rush toward the chosen point, damaging creatures contacted along the path. Resources are spent on release. The skill itself grants no light shield; mind the destination and surroundings. LV4 · Requires: Meltdowner 100%
ac.ability.meltdowner.mine_ray_basic.des: Hold on a block to mine it with a collection beam and produce drops. Useful for ranged mining; hardness, tool suitability and protection determine eligibility. LV3 · Requires: Meltdowner 30%
ac.ability.meltdowner.mine_ray_expert.de: Hold to cast an expert mining beam up to {{reach}} m, continuously mining advanced materials; release to stop. Equip and cast it separately: it is not passive. Costs CP every tick and respects hardness, harvest level and protection. LV4 · Requires: Basic Mining Ray 80%
ac.ability.meltdowner.mine_ray_luck.desc: Hold to cast a {{reach}} m Fortune mining beam; release to stop. A separate active skill with Fortune III for eligible ore drops. Costs CP every tick; extra yield still follows each block’s own random drop rules. LV5 · Requires: Expert Mining Ray 100% LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative. A complete cast may break at most 512 blocks; a continuous hold counts as one cast.
ac.ability.meltdowner.electron_missile.d: Hold to maintain electron orbs for about 4–10 seconds. Each shot selects the nearest other living entity inside a caster-centred {{reach_novice}}–{{reach_mastered}} m sphere; starting mastery fixes its radius and lifetime. Acquisition can cross walls and select allies. Each beam uses the existing damage, shield and mitigation rules. Releasing stops attacks; lingering light deals no damage. LV5 · Requires: Jet Engine 30%. The continuous boundary shows current acquisition reach, not simultaneous damage to everyone inside it.

ac.ability.vecmanip.dir_shock.desc: Hold for 0.35 to 2.45 seconds, then release a punch at a target within {{reach}} m in front. Releasing earlier or later cancels. Useful for melee openings and making space. LV1
ac.ability.vecmanip.ground_shock.desc: Hold to prepare, then release a ground stomp that propagates forward, launching contacted targets and affecting destructible terrain. You must be grounded on release. Useful against ground groups; terrain and protection constrain the wave. LV1 · Requires: Directed Shock
ac.ability.vecmanip.vec_accel.desc: Hold to charge, then release a forward acceleration burst; maximum thrust is reached after 1 second. At 50% mastery or below, nearby ground is required; higher mastery allows airborne use. Collisions still apply. LV2 · Requires: Directed Shock
ac.ability.vecmanip.vec_deviation.desc: Maintain vector deviation to reduce supported melee damage and slow incoming projectiles until they fall. A defensive option that spends CP when handling attacks; does not guarantee protection against every modded source. LV2 · Requires: Vector Acceleration
ac.ability.vecmanip.dir_blast.desc: Hold to aim at a nearby target, then release a concentrated blast. Heavily strikes creatures or breaks directly hit blocks for close-range breakthroughs; hardness and protection still apply. LV3 · Requires: Groundshock
ac.ability.vecmanip.storm_wing.desc: Tap to charge and deploy wings, steer with movement keys, and tap again to stop. Cruise costs and heat are reduced; hovering halves them again. At 85% heat, speed drops to 60% while cooling, returning to full at 60% heat. CP exhaustion still ends flight; airborne exit grants 4 seconds of slow falling. Low mastery can disturb fragile blocks. LV3 · Requires: Vector Acceleration
ac.ability.vecmanip.blood_retro.desc: Hold while closing on a target, then release a heavy blood-flow reversal hit at close range; preparation lasts at most 1.5 seconds. Slows you while preparing. A strong finite-damage single-target attack, not a guaranteed kill. LV4 · Requires: Directed Blastwave
ac.ability.vecmanip.vec_reflection.desc: Maintain advanced vector reflection to send supported projectiles toward your aim and counter handled direct attacks. Useful for ranged retaliation; cost rises with incoming threats and protection is not unlimited. LV4 · Requires: Vector Deviation
ac.ability.vecmanip.plasma_cannon.desc: LV5 area finisher. Hold to gather air into a plasma mass, then release after charging to throw it forward for an impact burst. Heavy ranged firepower requiring preparation and resources; mind the terrain along its path. LV5 · Requires: Storm Wing LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative. A complete cast may break at most 512 blocks; a continuous hold counts as one cast.

ac.ability.electromaster.forked_arc.name: Forked Arc
ac.ability.electromaster.forked_arc.desc: Tap to arc up to {{reach}} m, hitting a primary target and up to 2 visible conductive targets. Sneak-tap hits only the primary target. Best against wet or arc-marked groups. LV1
ac.ability.electromaster.magnetic_bracer: Hold to deflect recognized metal arrows within 4 m and a forward 120° cone. Release to stop. Its deflection does not cover rear attacks, melee or beams. LV1 · Requires: Forked Arc
ac.ability.electromaster.charge_decoy.de: Hold to preview, then release a temporary charge decoy that diverts recognized ordinary metal arrows. Affects at most 4 per second, creating room to reposition without spending shield. LV2 · Requires: Magnetic Bracer
screen.academy.highpower.learn_notice: Learning grants your ability's base shield: eligible damage spends shield first, and overflow reduces HP. Shield remaining grants knockback resistance; breaking it removes that protection. Each category adds electric retaliation, thermal projectile removal, phase evasion or vector reflection. Directional skills add interception and reserves with their own limits and costs. Relearning or switching never refills HP, shield or CP.

ac.ability.electromaster.polarity_tether: Tap a magnetic surface within {{reach}} m to anchor a tether, tap again to pull toward it, and tap a third time to brake. A lost anchor releases the tether but leaves existing momentum. LV1 · Requires: Forked Arc
ac.ability.electromaster.conductive_circ: Tap to place ground anchors A and B, then tap again to energize the circuit for {{duration_ticks:s}} second; enemies whose feet cross the A-B line while it is live are shocked (standing still on it does not count). Sneak-tap recalls it. Anchors need visibility within {{placement_reach}} m and a separation of at most {{reach}} m. LV2 · Requires: Forked Arc
ac.ability.electromaster.grounding_retur: Sneak-tap for a 3-second grounded stance with a 0.3-second precision window. The stance costs no CP. Supported electric hits spend shield; the first precise absorption refunds that expenditure up to 20% of capacity. Moving, leaving ground or releasing sneak ends it; no HP or CP healing. LV2 · Requires: Magnetic Bracer
ac.ability.electromaster.magnetic_ground: Disable auto-jump and tap while sprinting forward on level, fully supported ordinary ground such as grass, stone or logs. Adds forward assistance for up to {{duration_ticks}} ticks. The {{base_distance}} m base range grows to {{base_distance:q3}} m at LV3 and up to {{base_distance:q5}} m at LV5; native travel stays at or below 0.4 m per tick. Releasing forward, jumping, opening a screen or approaching an unsafe edge ends assistance while preserving inertia. Deflects at most 1 incoming arrow; cannot pass walls or erase fall damage. LV3 · Requires: Polarity Tether
academy.highpower.ground_step.autojump: Turn off Auto-Jump before using Magnetic Ground Step
academy.highpower.ground_step.settling: Move normally for a moment after turning off Auto-Jump
academy.highpower.ground_step.ground: Magnetic Ground Step needs continuous, flat, ordinary solid ground
academy.highpower.ground_step.input: Sprint forward without jumping or crouching

academy.urban.paper_hint: Build three owned paper supports over the gold and iron sockets. Stand on the bridge and use the raised table. Sneak-use a sword to challenge a guard.
academy.urban.message.calibrator_shutdow: Control bus disconnected. The calibrator has stopped.
academy.urban.help.equipment: Equipment: speak to guides and witnesses; use honey bottles for injured residents, a book at bookshelves, and a compass at cyan marks. Operate lecterns and facility levers.
academy.urban.help.ability: Ability: place three of your own physical paper supports above the gold and iron sockets. Stand on your bridge and use the raised cartography table. The supports are consumed. Mental Probe can read the verified witness; a paid arc can operate real nodes.
academy.urban.help.combat: Combat: sneak-use a sword on a raised table, clue fixture or story resident to challenge its bound guard. Defeat that guard to verify the action. Ordinary mobs do not grant story clues.
academy.urban.help.final: Finale: clear all three nodes and guide the rescued student out of the facility. Start the calibrator, then defeat it, sneak-use three redstone at its amethyst control, or solve the paper control puzzle.
academy.urban.help.media: You may mix routes between objectives; the terminal records actual methods. Water needs an existing source, paper consumes real sheets, and Liquid Shadow shares only hearing and touch unless equipped with an external observer module.

ac.ability.float_dial.float_hover.desc: LV2. Requires: Buoyant Lift. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Hold your current altitude briefly in air.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_ascent.name: Buoyant Ascent
ac.ability.float_dial.float_ascent.desc: LV2. Requires: Buoyant Lift. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Rise slowly through buoyant air.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_descent.name: Buoyant Descent
ac.ability.float_dial.float_descent.desc: LV2. Requires: Buoyant Lift. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Descend under controlled buoyancy.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_air_brake.de: LV3. Requires: Buoyant Rescue. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Dampen falling and horizontal motion.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_ally_hover.d: LV3. Requires: Buoyant Rescue. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Hold a consenting airborne teammate at their height.
LV3. Requires: Buoyant Rescue. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Lift a consenting airborne teammate slowly.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_ally_descent: LV4. Requires: Buoyant Rescue. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Lower a consenting airborne teammate safely.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_suspend.name: Hostile Suspension
ac.ability.float_dial.float_suspend.desc: LV3. Requires: Buoyant Lift. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Use buoyancy to hold a targeted hostile toward {{rise_limit}} blocks above its starting position for up to {{duration_ticks:s}} seconds.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_hostile_desc: LV4. Requires: Hostile Suspension. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Lower a hostile under control without adding fall damage.
LV5. Requires: Buoyancy Field. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Use buoyancy to hold all eligible nearby hostiles within 32–{{radius}} blocks toward {{rise_limit}} blocks above their starting positions for up to {{duration_ticks:s}} seconds. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative. Affects targets meeting the original conditions; this skill deals no direct damage.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_rescue_field: LV5. Requires: Buoyant Rescue. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Brake falling for yourself and consenting teammates. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative. Affects targets meeting the original conditions; this skill deals no direct damage.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_item_shelf.d: LV3. Requires: Lift Owned Item. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Hold your own dropped item near its original position.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_item_orbit.d: LV4. Requires: Lift Owned Item. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Orbit your own dropped item around you briefly.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_item_shelf_f: LV5. Requires: Owned Item Field. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Hold all eligible of your own drops within 32–{{radius}} blocks in place for up to {{duration_ticks:s}} seconds. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative. Affects targets meeting the original conditions; this skill deals no direct damage.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_turn.des: LV2. Requires: Liquid Scout. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Turn the real liquid body in place toward the current heading, even while paused.
LV2. Requires: Liquid Scout. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Toggle bounded backward steps relative to the player’s heading.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_intercep: LV3. Requires: Liquid Guard. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Actively deflect one real hostile arrow approaching the body at a shield cost.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_route.de: LV4. Requires: Liquid Touch Probe. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Walk the body toward a visible same-height floor waypoint, stopping at physical obstructions.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_screen.d: LV4. Requires: Liquid Intercept. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Actively deflect up to {{target_cap}} real incoming hostile arrows within {{radius}} blocks of the body, paying shield for each.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_survey.d: LV4. Requires: Liquid Touch Probe. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Sense physical contact with a creature without visual information or identity.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_dual_sen: LV5. Requires: Liquid Listening, Liquid Contact Survey. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Report a recent real sound and physical creature contact without visual information. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_ram: LV2. Requires: Paper Steps. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Consume eight sheets to build four solid rising steps.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_lif: LV3. Requires: Paper Walkway. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Consume eight sheets to build a four-block bridge rising one block midway.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_cov: LV3. Requires: Paper Screen. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Consume twelve sheets to build a temporary three-wide, two-high solid screen.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_pla: LV4. Requires: Paper Platform. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Consume eighteen sheets to build a temporary solid three-by-three platform.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_puz: LV4. Requires: Paper Pressure Plate. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Consume four sheets to assemble a solid support and pressure plate that emits real redstone when stepped on.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_cat: LV5. Requires: Paper Walkway. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Consume ten sheets to build a temporary five-block transverse walkway. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_swi: LV5. Requires: Paper Button, Paper Gate. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Consume six sheets to assemble a support, button and paper gate; real redstone opens the bridge surface. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_eme: LV5. Requires: Paper Steps. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Consume eight sheets to build four temporary descending escape steps. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative.
LV2. Requires: Liquid Scout. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Have the existing shadow contact a hostile and restrict its horizontal movement for up to {{duration_ticks:s}} seconds.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_contact_: LV3. Requires: Liquid Strike. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Cut a targeted hostile in direct contact with the existing shadow.
LV4. Requires: Liquid Strike. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Sweep up to {{target_cap}} hostiles in contact range, sharing one damage budget.

LV5. Requires: Contact Cut. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Crush a hostile in close contact and restrict its horizontal movement for up to {{duration_ticks:s}} seconds on hit. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative.
item.academy.mental_remote.desc: Hold it: the four scan skills reach 32 blocks instead of 24, and scanned enemies get a gold star mark.
item.academy.dark_matter_crystal.desc: Fuel for Dark Synthesis (one crystal duplicates one item). Also carried: Dark Wings and Dark Matter guards and Wing Shelter last 50% longer, one crystal per cast.
item.academy.nitrogen_canister.desc: Carry it: Nitrogen Dash and Nitrogen Rocket push 25% harder. One canister per cast.
item.academy.aero_pressure_chip.desc: Carry it: Ring Push hits one more target, and Aero pressure walls stop one more arrow. One chip when the extra is used.
item.academy.water_flask.desc: Four charges. Use on a block to place a real water source; use on water to refill. Hydro Hand then works anywhere.
item.academy.buoyancy_float.desc: Right-click a block to set a marker; sneak and use in the air to clear. Buoyancy fields then pick enemies and items nearest the marker.
item.academy.origami_paper.desc: Treated sheets for Paper Psychokinesis. Counts as one sheet for paper skills.
ac.ability.mental_out.mental_puppet.name: Mind Puppet
ac.ability.mental_out.mental_puppet.desc: LV5. Requires: Hostile Conflict. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Turn one non-player creature you look at into your puppet for {{duration_ticks:s}} seconds: it stops attacking you and your allies, attacks nearby hostile creatures, and follows you when none are left. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative.
ac.ability.dark_matter.dark_synthesis.de: LV3. Requires: Dark Blade. Activate your ability and use its mapped key. Spend one Dark Matter Crystal to turn the item in your main hand into two, copying every data component exactly, including enchantments, names and container contents.

academy.city.message.mentor_guide: Use an advanced developer. To awaken, enter learn in its console. Skill prerequisites still apply. Rooftop turbines supply IF.
academy.city.message.library_wait: Find the training-room mentor before handing in Course Archive.

academy.city.guide.transfer_leaflet.1:
City transfers

East–west express: West End, West City, Central, East City and East End. Transfer at Central.
academy.city.guide.transfer_leaflet.2: The airport line, city ring and three underground lines serve additional stops. Use /aca_city map for the route.
academy.city.guide.ability_development_g:
Ability development

Use a developer. Enter learn to awaken. An induction factor selects a category; skills require their level and prerequisites.
The four D7 advanced developers are free to use. Development consumes stored IF; rooftop wind generators recharge them through the wireless node.
academy.city.guide.if_wiring_card.1:
Imaginary Flux

Generators store IF. A wireless node connects generators to receivers within its range, capacity and bandwidth.
academy.city.guide.if_wiring_card.2: Open a device’s wireless page and connect a nearby node. The D7 lab node is on the middle floor; its machines and turbines are preconnected.
academy.city.talk.student.0: I have ability practice today; the course guide is useful.
academy.city.talk.student.1: After class I might stop by the canteen or library.
academy.city.talk.student.night: It is late; take care on the way back to the dorm.
academy.city.talk.commuter.0: I always check the platform information before leaving.
academy.city.talk.commuter.1: After work I might grab a bite in the shopping district.
academy.city.talk.commuter.night: Heading home before the last service; I hope the transfer is smooth.
academy.city.talk.visitor.0: The city is large; station and street signs help with directions.
academy.city.talk.visitor.1: I hope to see the campus and the wind turbines.
academy.city.talk.visitor.night: The night view is lovely, but I should head back to the station.
academy.city.talk.shop.0: Welcome! Counter goods can be purchased with City Coins.
academy.city.talk.shop.1: After arranging the shelves I need to check the restock list.
academy.city.talk.shop.night: Some counters are still open in the evening.
academy.city.talk.barista.0: The cafe has drinks and snacks; take a look.
academy.city.talk.barista.1: Today’s beans smell wonderful; I will arrange the cups.
academy.city.talk.barista.night: The cafe rests at night. See you tomorrow.
academy.city.talk.resident.0: The nearby paths are good for a walk, especially in the evening.
academy.city.talk.resident.1: I will pick up dinner and take my time heading home.
academy.city.talk.resident.night: The streets are quieter at night. Watch the crossings.
academy.city.talk.researcher.0: Keep experiment records filed; the library has useful references.
academy.city.talk.researcher.1: Both safety and basic practice matter for ability development.
academy.city.talk.researcher.night: The notes are finished; I should check the equipment too.
academy.city.talk.teacher.0: The training machines are shared; check their IF before use.
academy.city.talk.teacher.1: Learn the basics first and follow each skill’s prerequisites.
academy.city.talk.teacher.night: Class is over; we can continue tomorrow.
academy.city.talk.guard.0: Please stay safe near crossings and platform doors.
academy.city.talk.guard.1: I patrol this area. The service counter can help with questions.
academy.city.talk.guard.night: We continue patrols at night. Watch your step.
academy.city.talk.technician.0: Check the node connections and IF reserve first.
academy.city.talk.technician.1: Keep clear of moving components while the turbine runs.
academy.city.talk.technician.night: The night shift includes an equipment check.
academy.city.talk.athlete.0: Warm up before training; do not rush.
academy.city.talk.athlete.1: The sports field has a track and a place to rest.
academy.city.talk.athlete.night: Remember to hydrate and rest when training late.
academy.city.talk.performer.0: I need to rehearse the rhythm once more before the show.
academy.city.talk.performer.1: Thanks for stopping by. Have a good day!
academy.city.talk.performer.night: I will put the props away before heading home.
academy.city.talk.airport.0: The terminal has a service counter; check your direction before departure.
academy.city.talk.airport.1: Keep your belongings close and follow the transfer signs.
academy.city.talk.airport.night: The terminal counter remains staffed at night.
academy.city.talk.rail.0: Central Station offers transfers; check the line and direction.
academy.city.talk.rail.1: Board after the platform doors open and mind the gap.
academy.city.talk.rail.night: Please check platform information at night as well.
academy.city.talk.medic.0: Rest after training, and ask for help if you feel unwell.
academy.city.talk.medic.1: Hydration and regular rest are important too.
academy.city.talk.medic.night: Take care of yourself during the night shift.
academy.city.talk.shared.food: That looks tasty. Remember to take a break when you get tired.
academy.city.dialogue.choose: Choose a topic on the right. Use its wheel or arrows to change pages. I will resume my day afterwards.
academy.city.dialogue.local_help: Service staff offer shopping, work orders and professional help. Order details show the recipient and coordinates; your journal keeps active orders.
academy.city.dialogue.heal_info: Treatment costs 4 coins: restores health and removes poison / weakness. Healthy patients pay nothing. Ability CP and overload use their existing recovery.
academy.city.dialogue.repair_info: Hold a damaged tool or armor item. Full durability repair costs 3–8 coins based on wear and preserves enchantments. Energy charging uses the original power facilities.
academy.city.dialogue.guide_intro: D7’s second school has four public advanced developers using the original awakening and learning system. Choose a topic. The library also receives document work orders.
academy.city.dialogue.guide_awaken: Right-click a native advanced developer and follow its awakening interface. A matching induction factor selects a category; otherwise the original random selection applies. Public machine use is free, while development consumes its IF.
academy.city.dialogue.guide_learn: Open the machine’s native skill tree. Learning follows your category, level, prerequisite skills and experience. NPC demonstrations do not grant player skills or replace development.
academy.city.dialogue.guide_power: Native roof turbines feed the four developers through the advanced wireless IF node. Public machines start with 100,000 IF and refill through wind generation. Keep the public network connected.

academy.city.esper.rules: Practice spends CP, adds overload and uses native skill cooldowns. Offensive practice fires into empty space. Sparring and defense can damage or control valid targets. Paper, needles and shadow medium are finite; water skills need a nearby source.
academy.city.esper.electro.name: Electromaster / circuit trainee
academy.city.esper.electro.description: Uses native Arc Generation, with Thunder Bolt unlocked at higher levels. Hits deal skill damage and spend CP / overload.
academy.city.esper.melt.name: Meltdowner / beam technician
academy.city.esper.melt.description: Uses Electron Bomb; level 3 unlocks charged Meltdowner. Native charge ticks, energy drain and wide-beam hits apply without destroying city blocks.
academy.city.esper.teleport.name: Teleporter / logistics aide
academy.city.esper.teleport.description: Spends needles on Threatening Teleport. Level 2 adds Mark Teleport for positioning, and level 3 Flesh Ripping. Movement requires a supported collision-free landing.
academy.city.esper.vector.name: Vector control / cushioning trainee
academy.city.esper.vector.description: Uses Directed Shock with native knockback; level 3 unlocks Directed Blastwave. Winds up visibly and retreats when resources run low.
academy.city.esper.mental.name: Mental Out / rhythm guide
academy.city.esper.mental.description: Uses Mental Probe and, at level 3, Mental Disrupt to interrupt hostile mobs. It does not take over player input.
academy.city.esper.air.name: Aero Hand / airflow trainee
academy.city.esper.air.description: Uses Aero Push for damage / displacement and Aero Jet to reposition, using the original skill ranges and motion parameters.
academy.city.esper.float.name: Float Dial / light-load trainee
academy.city.esper.float.description: Uses Float Lift to physically raise hostile mobs. Higher levels add suspension and rescue. Effects use real movement and gravity.
academy.city.esper.nitrogen.name: Nitrogen armor / venue safety aide
academy.city.esper.nitrogen.description: Creates a timed, finite nitrogen shell depleted by incoming attacks. Level 3 can perform Nitrogen Punch while the shell is active.
academy.city.esper.dark.name: Dark matter / structure researcher
academy.city.esper.dark.description: Forms Dark Blades or fires Dark Shards. Level 3 adds wing mobility. Skills spend resources and deal real damage without creating collectible matter.
academy.city.esper.water.name: Hydro Hand / supply aide
academy.city.esper.water.description: Uses a real water source within six blocks for Hydro Whip; level 3 adds Hydro Shield. Without a source, it must reposition or evade.
academy.city.esper.paper.name: Paper psychokinesis / paper-art trainee
academy.city.esper.paper.description: Spends carried paper on Paper Blade; level 3 can spend three sheets on finite Paper Armor. Combat does not refill materials.
academy.city.esper.shadow.name: Liquid shadow / stage aide
academy.city.esper.shadow.description: Consumes dense medium to form a real liquid shadow body, which approaches targets for contact attacks while the owner manages range and resources.

academy.city.quest.repeat_office.name: Repeat / coworking documents
academy.city.quest.repeat_office.brief: Bring two paper, ride from Central Transfer to South Commercial and alight, then report to the coworking room agent.
academy.city.quest.repeat_return.name: Repeat / return to campus
academy.city.quest.repeat_return.brief: Ride from South Commercial back to Campus, alight and report to the campus commuter librarian.
academy.city.quest.repeat_cafe.name: Repeat / cafe supplies
academy.city.quest.repeat_cafe.brief: Take a restocking request from West Kiosk and deliver one cocoa bean to East Cafe.
academy.city.quest.repeat_wind.name: Repeat / wind-farm inspection
academy.city.quest.repeat_wind.brief: Visit the wind-farm access inspection point and return to the engineer. Each new contract requires another visit.
ac.ability.mental_out.mental_neural_stin: LV1. Tap to focus on one visible enemy within {{reach}} blocks. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, deliver one neural strike. Cover or leaving range cancels the cast. Requires learned Mental Probe.
ac.ability.mental_out.mental_synaptic_bu: LV2. Tap to strike up to {{target_cap}} visible enemies in a forward cone within {{reach}} blocks after {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds. Share one damage budget and slow victims for {{control_ticks:s}} seconds. Requires learned Neural Sting.
ac.ability.mental_out.mental_feedback_sp: LV3. Focus on one visible enemy within {{reach}} blocks for {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds. Converging signals deal one focused hit and interrupt a mob’s navigation. Requires learned Sensory Shock.
ac.ability.mental_out.mental_cortical_wa: LV4. Select a centre within {{reach}} blocks. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, strike up to {{target_cap}} visible enemies inside {{radius}} blocks and slow them for {{control_ticks:s}} seconds. One damage budget is shared. Requires learned Feedback Spike.
ac.ability.mental_out.mental_resonance_c: LV5. Select a centre within {{reach}} blocks. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, link all eligible visible enemies inside 32–{{radius}} blocks, share one hit, and slow them for {{control_ticks:s}} seconds. Signals respect cover. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative. Group selection includes every eligible target in range. Shared-damage skills still divide one whole-cast budget. Requires learned Cortical Wave.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_buoyant_stri: LV1. Focus on a visible enemy within {{reach}} blocks for {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds. A sudden buoyancy change strikes and lifts it for about 1.5 seconds, opening a Reversal Drop. Requires learned Buoyant Lift.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_reversal_dro: LV2. Aim at an already airborne enemy within {{reach}} blocks. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, reverse its buoyancy into one downward strike. Chain from Lift, Buoyant Impact or Hostile Suspension. Grounded targets are refused.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_counterpulse: LV3. Tap to build opposing buoyant layers in a forward cone. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, strike and briefly lift up to {{target_cap}} visible enemies within {{reach}} blocks. Share one damage budget. Requires learned Reversal Drop.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_pressure_dro: LV4. Select a density centre within {{reach}} blocks. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, strike and push down up to {{target_cap}} visible enemies inside {{radius}} blocks. Share one damage budget. Requires learned Counterbuoyancy Pulse.
ac.ability.float_dial.float_collapse_fie: LV5. Select a centre within {{reach}} blocks. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, collapse fluid layers inside 32–{{radius}} blocks and strike all eligible visible enemies once. The total damage is shared. LV5 presentation spans multiple chunks; ambient light is decorative. Group selection includes every eligible target in range. Shared-damage skills still divide one whole-cast budget. Requires learned Density Drop.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_fol: LV2. Hold at least 3 sheets of paper in either hand. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, strike up to {{target_cap}} visible enemies in a {{reach}}-block cone. Consume 3 real sheets and share one hit. Requires learned Paper Blade.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_pie: LV3. Hold at least 2 sheets in either hand. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, pierce up to {{target_cap}} visible enemies along a {{reach}}-block line. Solid cover stops the line. Consume 2 sheets; share one damage budget. Requires learned Folded Paper Fan.
ac.ability.paper_psychokinesis.paper_ret: LV4. Hold at least 4 sheets in either hand and select a centre within {{reach}} blocks. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, cut up to {{target_cap}} visible enemies inside {{radius}} blocks. Consume 4 sheets and share one hit. Requires learned Paper Piercing Lance.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_touch_sp: LV1. First materialize your Liquid Scout. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, the real shadow strikes one visible enemy within {{radius}} blocks of its body. Keep the owner within {{reach}} blocks. Losing the body or contact cancels.
ac.ability.liquid_shadow.liquid_crosscut: LV2. Keep a real controlled shadow. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, crosscut up to {{target_cap}} visible enemies within {{radius}} blocks of its body. Share one damage budget; neither walls nor a missing body can be bypassed. Requires learned Liquid Contact Spike.
ac.ability.aero_hand.aero_pressure_bulle: LV1. Aim at an enemy within {{reach}} blocks and tap. After {{warmup_ticks:s}} seconds, release one precise compressed-air shot with light knockback. Cover and normal defenses still apply. Requires learned Air Jet.
